name: Case law: Poland, the Sąd Najwyższy (Supreme Court)
label: Poland case law (the Sąd Najwyższy (Supreme Court))
coverage: 38080 judgments with text from SAOS, one file and one commit each, dated the day given; 280530 citations of law linked to poland-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day given. Judgments with no usable date are in decisions/undated/. SAOS holds no judgment of the Sąd Najwyższy (Supreme Court) given after 2016-06-22: later judgments are not in this record, though it was checked against SAOS on 2026-11-07.

source.publisher: SAOS, System Analizy Orzeczeń Sądowych (saos.org.pl), from the courts' own portals
source.licence: Judgments are official documents, not subject to copyright (Art. 4 of the Polish Copyright Act); SAOS states no reuse conditions
